visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white lace floral dress and a matching floral headscarf, sits on a rustic wooden bench. Three small squirrel monkeys are perched on her: one on her head, one on her right shoulder, and one on her left arm. She smiles brightly at the camera with her hands raised in a playful, welcoming gesture. The background features a large weathered wooden pillar and a wire mesh enclosure with lush green shrubbery visible behind it. (2) A zookeeper wearing a bright teal and black uniform enters from the right side of the frame, holding a clear plastic cup filled with small food items. As the zookeeper approaches, more monkeys rapidly scurry from the wooden structure behind the woman, swarming around her and the food container. The woman's expression shifts to one of playful surprise as she tries to balance the increasing number of animals climbing onto her. (3) The woman takes the food cup from the zookeeper. Over a dozen squirrel monkeys now cover her torso, arms, and lap, eagerly reaching for the food. She holds the cup in one hand and uses the other to secure her headscarf. The monkeys are highly active, jumping and climbing over each other in a frantic but harmless manner. The woman maintains a joyful and laughing expression throughout the intense encounter, sitting in the brightly lit, airy animal enclosure until the end of the clip.
